name: Buried Caches
blurb: You leave supplies behind for the next world, the way travelers leave firewood for strangers.

name: Tuned Flywheels
blurb: Your machines remember their rhythm from world to world, and settle into it a little quicker.

name: Steady Hands
blurb: You have done this before. The close calls stay close calls a little longer.

name: Deep Cells
blurb: A bigger reserve of attention. Each level holds one more decision before you need to rest.

name: Patient Orbit
blurb: The world learns to keep itself a few hours longer while you are elsewhere, living.
